additional_info.subject: ID0367334-DC/Si-D/DE[170002551] - OCPP offline CRM:00315001557
additional_info.body:
Hello Oliver﻿, I hope you are doing fine.﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / R0 170002551
ChargerID/Serial No.
: C4RAaL
Problem Description
: OCPP is offline
Troubleshooting
:
I have accessed the charger remotely and restarted the connection to OCPP.
Can you please confirm that everything is working fine?
If yes, then I can close the ticket.
Before I close the ticket, I would like to offer you a configuration change on the router and here is how it works:
The router pings 8.8.8.8 (DNS google), every 5mins, and if the ping doesn't return after 2 attempts (retry count), it will Restart the mobile connection, which is what I did to recover the connection right now.
I will wait for your feedback before I do any change. I already tested with this configuration change with a few selected routers and the connection was improved, or at least the downtime was reduced.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0367334
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
